title: "A Beautiful Graphic"
author: "Ashlan Guengerich"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| warning: false
mpg |>
  ggplot(aes(x = displ, y = hwy, color = class)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, color = "gray30", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Engine Size vs. Highway Fuel Efficiency",
    subtitle = "Larger engines generally get fewer miles per gallon on the highway",
    x = "Engine Displacement (Liters)",
    y = "Highway Fuel Economy (MPG)",
    color = "Vehicle Class",
    caption = "Source: EPA fuel economy data (ggplot2::mpg)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```
